Overview
There are few models more deserving of their moniker than Bentley’s Continental GT. Here is a grand tourer that can cross continents really rather rapidly and with consummate ease, all the while enveloping its passengers in the lap of luxury. It really is the Ronseal of car names and the Continental GT continues to seduce to this day, all the while retaining its original design language. If it ain't broke...
Debuting all the way back in 2002 at the Paris Motor Show the Bentley Continental GT now belongs firmly in the modern classic category and makes for an excellent used purchase today, especially these earlier models where there are plenty of excellent examples from which to choose. With a whopping great 552bhp, 6.0-litre twin-turbo W12 under the bonnet driving all four wheels performance was never lacking and when combined with that subtle, yet elegantly muscular styling it's really no wonder that the Continental GT dug Bentley out of a hole, going on to become one of its most successful models.
This low mileage black over cream example comes with lots of stamps in the service history as well as a long, advisory-free MOT, which is exactly what you want to see when buying a used car of this nature. Being a post-2005 facelift model the car features an improved interior, too and the vendor reports that it's driving well. In summary, it’s a very usable, early Bentley Continental GT with strong history in a great colour combination. What a great way to waft to your destination, near or far.

Summary
If you buy a Bentley Continental GT without the express intention of driving it as much as possible then you're doing it wrong and this car is the perfect embodiment of a usable example. Yes it would no doubt benefit from a machine polish and some paint correction but it's obviously been well maintained with a service and MOT history to corroborate, which is arguably way more important than any minor exterior blemishes, so get it bought and get it on the road where it belongs.
